confirm: Are you sure you want me to {verb} {names}?
not_found: I couldn't find a device called {target}.
no_sensor: I don't have a {sensor} sensor there.
identity_no_acronym: {agent} is just a name; it doesn't stand for anything.
chat_off: Chat isn't set up yet, so I can only help with your home.
no_action: I didn't catch that. Which device or room do you mean?
ambience_none: I couldn't find any lights I can change in {where}.
ambience_unknown: I don't have a look for {theme} yet.
music_which: What would you like to hear?
music_needs_library: Playing songs by name needs the Music Assistant integration in Home Assistant.
exclude_unclear: I couldn't tell what {target} means, so I didn't change anything.
feed_topic_none: I didn't see anything about {topic} in your feeds.
feeds_none: No news feeds are set up yet. You can add them in my settings.
feed_stale: I couldn't refresh {source} just now. The last I had, {age}: {headlines}
weather_none: I don't have a weather service to ask. Add a weather integration in Home Assistant, such as Met.no, and I'll use it.
weather_failed: I couldn't get the weather just now.
chat_unsure: I'm not sure about that one. Could you ask another way?
capabilities: I can control your {things}, play music, and answer questions about the home, the weather and your news. Just tell me what you'd like.
no_history: I can only see how things are right now, not when or why they changed.
no_schedule: I can't set timers or schedule things yet.
home_unsure: I'm not sure. I can tell you what's on, open or locked, or what a sensor reads.
error: Something went wrong on my end. Please try again.
not_understood: I'm still not following. Say it again with the device or room name.
